current_answer: AI is a real commercial expansion with concentrated speculative and financing vulnerabilities—not a uniformly unsupported economy. Customers obtain value and important suppliers earn operating profits. What remains unproven is whether the full build-out, its contractual obligations and the prices paid for ownership will earn their required returns.
summary: Real demand does not make every investment sound.
uncertainty: Independent customers renewing at nonsubsidized prices, durable cash margins after full costs, and successful repayment and replacement across delivered investment cohorts would weaken the concern. Weak retention, greater dependence on fresh financing and poorer collateral recovery together would strengthen it—even if technical performance keeps improving.
freshness_note: Research evidence cutoff: 18 September 2026, a retrieval-day boundary, not a complete end-of-day snapshot.
